notes: NVIDIA repositories are used as reference architecture, interoperability
contracts and simulation patterns. No NVIDIA code is vendored into AURA,
no live DSX gateway is contacted, and no NVIDIA certification, validation

upstream.used_for: Kit application/service packaging patterns for the future viewport bridge.
Prim-path addressing for AURA asset mappings.
Data-centre digital-twin workflow and CFD/thermal scenario patterns.
DSX asset, telemetry and exchange semantics informing the AURA event envelope.
Candidate surrogate-model runtime for calibrated thermal prediction.

prohibited: vendoring NVIDIA source into the AURA repository
contacting a live DSX gateway from this build
